config.implementation: independent exhaustive small-system L1 reference; not production WZZT

a2.price_units: normalized synthetic rebate, 0.1 per unit in preferred slot; no currency calibration
a2.response_model: synthetic feasible two-slot energy shift; not iFlex-calibrated
a2.parameter_bound_policy: nonnegative; zero allowed; no positive floor or added upper bound
a2.hypotheses: all complete laminar supports compatible with historical loss threshold; one LP representative plus explicit nonuniqueness audit; NOT a covering parameter ensemble
a2.weights: uniform over deduplicated fitted prediction models; design weights, NOT topology posterior
a2.primary_output: price ranking versus independently realized correct single-block selection

promotion.A1_to_A2: all deterministic reference checks pass; retain contrary results as evidence
promotion.A2_to_B1: no oracle leakage, plausible rankings improve actual selection beyond matched-resource random/D-opt baselines; investigate candidate-pool and optimal-face limitations first
promotion.B1: 40 independent episodes, 5 policies, 4 batches; only after A2 review
promotion.B2: freeze model and test size using B1 variance; 300 independent complete episodes is a possible fixed-size low-error audit, not an automatic launch
promotion.C: AC 33-bus and one public LV case after small closed-loop benefit and runtime are established

hard_stops: false certificate in a noiseless counterexample
test truth or future observations used to design prices
score improves but selection does not
surrogate ranks prices differently without adequate correction
benefit requires stronger perturbations or higher cost
discarding weak/zero cases to obtain positive results
config.resume: validate config and source hashes; append only missing rows; retain failed rows; never silently reuse a run with changed sources
